issue.title: bob ref attach-source: resolve the 47 ambiguous and 35 title-mismatched agent-report backfill skips

task_type_fields.proposal:
Finish the `bob ref attach-source` backfill for the 82 agent-report references that the
bob-cli-cc.6 run skipped as `ambiguous` (47) or `title mismatch` (35).

- **Ambiguous (47):** the plan-vs-report stem collision in the sase research sidecar,
  e.g. `sase/repos/plans/202608/X.md` vs `202608/X/X.md`. Today `attach-source` skips
  any stem with two candidates (src/native/ref_library/attach.rs, candidate selection
  returns `Err("ambiguous")`). Proposal: verify every candidate for that stem against
  the library PDF text and attach only when exactly one passes. Keep skipping when zero
  or several pass.
- **Title mismatch (35):** renamed reports. Attach them with explicit
  `bob ref attach-source REF -s FILE` after a human checks the pairing, or add a
  reviewed title-alias rule. Do not loosen the block-match threshold.
- Then dry-run on athena with every research sidecar as `-s`, review the counts, and run
  the write pass in batches (each one revertable commit), as the original phase did.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope:
Proposed by phase bob-cli-cc.6 (note #4) while landing epic bob-cli-cc. The epic's plan
explicitly chose "two candidates for one stem means a skip (ambiguous)". The phase ran
the backfill and passed its gate (235 attached, 67% of compared candidates verified,
gate 60%). These skips are the designed remainder, not a defect in the shipped command,
so smarter disambiguation and a second write pass are new scope beyond the epic.

issue.creation_reason: The bob-cli-cc.6 backfill left 82 agent reports without saved sources because of stem collisions and renamed reports; proposed as follow-up by bob-cli-cc.6 note #4.
